before_after_design.comparison: paired facility-level MODIS annual mean LST
before_after_design.interpretation: Descriptive temporal comparison; not a causal intervention estimate.

multiple_testing_correction: Holm correction across available day/night comparisons

environmental_screening.title: Environmental condition screening
limitations: This is a relative screening score, not a certification of environmental safety.
MODIS land-surface temperature is not ground-level air temperature.
Pollution exposure, flood hazard, water quality and biodiversity indicators are not represented by these criteria.
Lower temperature is treated only as a thermal-condition proxy.
Scores are relative percentile ranks within this dataset.

industrial_site_suitability.title: Corrected exploratory industrial site suitability
industrial_site_suitability.weighting_method: Equal weights among available criteria for each facility; weights are renormalized when criteria are missing.

wind_mapping.measurement: Mean daily WS10M_m_per_s by grid cell

limitations: Exploratory relative ranking, not regulatory approval.
MODIS LST is not ground-level air temperature.
Wind measurements are grid-cell averages associated with mapped facilities.
Solar GHI is available for only a small fraction of facilities.
Weights are renormalized among available criteria per facility.
Infrastructure, zoning, water availability, pollution, hazards and ecological constraints are not fully represented.

data_quality_notes: MODIS temperature comparisons use non-null temperatures from the corrected QC database.
Only facilities with valid observations in both years are included in paired comparisons.
Confidence intervals describe the paired mean difference.
P-values are adjusted for the day/night comparison family using Holm correction.
MCDA uses relative percentile normalization and equal weights.
